pr_body:
This change drops single and double quotes from the C-standard flag lookup that occurs in `NativeImageOptions`; this will mean that passing `c99`, `C99`, `"C99"`, `'c99'`, and so on, all resolve via the `CStandards` enum.

Fixes and closes #6699
pr_title: fix: force-uppercase C-standard flag, trim, drop quotes

review_comment: one line change; for the sake of #6699, non-character/number inputs could simply be rejected, with a message not to include quotes. this felt simpler and more obvious, and with less risk, as the `CStandards` enum is unlikely to change often, but I can easily push a different PR if needed.
